# Editor tools

8 tools. Registered under `GODOT_MCP_PROFILE=core`.

[← All categories](README.md)

## `take_screenshot`

Capture a screenshot and save it to a file. Use viewport 'camera' to render the open scene through one of its own cameras — that is the view the player gets, and the only way to check an orthographic camera's framing. The running game's own window cannot be captured: it is a separate OS process.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `save_path` | `string` | — | Where to save the PNG (default: res://screenshot.png) |
| `viewport` | `string` | — | What to capture: 'editor' (whole window), '2d' or '3d' (the editor's own viewports), or 'camera' (render the scene through a Camera3D/Camera2D in it). Default: editor One of: `"editor"`, `"2d"`, `"3d"`, `"camera"`. |
| `camera_path` | `string` | — | viewport 'camera' only: scene-relative path of the Camera3D/Camera2D to render through. Defaults to the scene's current/enabled camera, else the first one found. |
| `width` | `number` | — | viewport 'camera' only: render width in pixels (default: the project's viewport width, 16-4096). |
| `height` | `number` | — | viewport 'camera' only: render height in pixels (default: the project's viewport height, 16-4096). |
| `transparent_bg` | `boolean` | — | viewport 'camera' only: render with a transparent background (default: false). |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/05-editor.json`, test E-04:

```json
{
  "save_path": "res://screenshot_a.png"
}
```

## `get_error_log`

Get recent errors and warnings from the newest Godot log file. The editor process writes no log — this reads what a running project logged, so play the scene first to see whether it starts clean.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `last_n_lines` | `number` | — | Number of lines to return from the end of the log (default: 100) |
| `filter` | `string` | — | Filter log entries (default: all). 'errors' and 'warnings' keep the indented location/backtrace lines that follow each entry. One of: `"all"`, `"errors"`, `"warnings"`. |
| `log_path` | `string` | — | Read this file instead of the newest log Godot wrote (res://, user:// or an absolute path). |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/05-editor.json`, test E-03:

```json
{}
```

## `execute_script`

Execute a GDScript snippet in the editor context (runs as EditorScript). Returns whatever _run() returns as 'result', and the text passed to mcp_print(...) as 'output'. await is supported: the call waits for the coroutine to finish.

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `code` | `string` | yes | GDScript code to execute. Wrapped in func _run(): automatically if needed. Use mcp_print(...) (same signature as print) to send text back in 'output' — plain print() only reaches Godot's Output panel. Return a value from _run() to get it back as 'result'. await works (e.g. await RenderingServer.frame_post_draw); the code after it runs before the tool responds. |
| `timeout` | `number` | — | Seconds to wait for the script to finish (default: 10, max: 60). On timeout the tool returns the output collected so far and the script keeps running in the editor. Note the MCP client gives up after 15s regardless. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/05-editor.json`, test E-08:

```json
{
  "code": "print(2 + 2)"
}
```

## `select_node_in_editor`

Select one or more nodes in the editor's Scene panel

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|:---:|---|
| `node_path` | `string` | yes | Path to the node to select |
| `additional_paths` | `array` | — | Additional node paths to add to the selection (multi-select) Array items are `string`. |

**Example** — the call the suite makes, from `e2e/blocks/05-editor.json`, test E-05:

```json
{
  "node_path": "."
}
```
